I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. The reply confirms that no action is needed on the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines and that the deadline is 21 October.

I checked the brain and #north-team, which she belongs to. Neither had anything else about Osprey, so I haven't done anything further. The brain had already saved her note, so the deadline is on record.
